en.description:
blkjk is a simple blackjack app for the Apple Watch.

Request a hit to draw a card, try to get as close to 21 as possible, but careful, don't go over or you will bust and lose the round! If you feel confident, you may double to try and get more points, but careful, you only get one more card. If you have two cards with the same value, you may also split them into two different hands, allowing you to play those simultaneously. Once you're happy with your cards, and think the dealer won't be able to beat their total count, stand, and let the dealer draw their own cards! Whose cards' total is closest to 21, but doesn't bust, wins the round. In this game the dealer stands on all 17s.

Throughout the game, try to get a bigger lead over the dealer to set a new high score. 

You can set your preferences, or delete your high score in the game's settings.
en.releaseNotes:
- Added the ability to have multiple hands
- Added the ability to split
- Added the ability to double
- Fixed bugs and improved app stability
en.subtitle: blackjack on your wrist

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
- Added wrist twisting gesture to stand in a round.
- Added the settings menu to enable/disable haptics and the twist gesture.
- Moved high score deletion to the settings menu.
- Fixed an issue, where if the Always On Display was disabled, the twist gesture detection wouldn’t work.

- Fixed issues with the way hands' scores were counted.
- Fixed issues with how decks are evaluated.
- The dealer now hits under 17, and stands on all 17s.

- Added the ability to have multiple hands
- Added the ability to split
- Added the ability to double
- Fixed bugs and improved app stability
